description: Master timeline registry for the Almaza, Sahel walkthrough reconstruction. Maps each split clip's LOCAL time to the MASTER timeline of the original full WhatsApp video. Rule: master_time = local_file_time + sum of durations of all prior split parts. Parts labelled source_type=original_full_video use their visible timestamps directly with NO offset.

timebase_rule.split_clips: master_time = local_file_time + offset_applied. Never seek master time inside a split file; always convert to local first. Never double-add offsets.
timebase_rule.original_full_video: visible timestamps are already master times; offset_applied = 0 and must stay 0.

parts.source_file: original full WhatsApp video (NOT among uploads)
parts.footage_resolution: COVERED by part_3.mp4: local = master - 111.38s, i.e. local 01:04.6 - 01:38.6. Frames extracted from part_3 at those local times.
parts.note: Do not add any offset to these anchors. The inverse mapping into part_3 is only for frame extraction.

parts.limitation: Original full video required to verify these anchors frame-by-frame.
